'''Kousa''' was a [[Nomai]] originally from [[the Vessel]] who landed on [[Brittle Hollow]] with [[Escape Pods|Escape Pod 1]].<ref>KOUSA: We can hear the other escape pods’ distress signals, which gives me hope.</ref> In the [[Brittle_Hollow#Original_Nomai_Settlement|temporary settlement]] on Brittle Hollow, they expressed how much they missed their partner [[Foli]] and wondered whether Foli was still alive.<ref>Foli, are you still here? I am unsure how to survive in this place without you. KOUSA: (I am unsure how to be me without you.)</ref>

== Trivia ==

* The ''[[Wikipedia:Cornus kousa|Cornus kousa]]'' is a small tree native to Eastern Asia with many ornamental uses.
